_comment: Sample host-shell override for `dotnet ef database update` runs executed OUTSIDE Docker. Copy to `appsettings.Development.json` (which SHOULD be gitignored) so the API project resolves Postgres at the host-published port. Compose-internal services do NOT need this file; they use `appsettings.json` (Host=db;Port=5432). See docs/local-setup.md.
